EOFCreate is the only opcode where the gas cost is dependent on the immediate, which makes it a bit of a pain to implement Is it depending on the immediate or the size of the container referenced by the immediate? But either way you need to know what container you are using. Create and memory expansion has memory available, correct? We merged all EOF changes in evmone. Now only test updates 🙂 Its dependent on the size of the container referenced by the immediate Yes, mem is available, just not the pc
